snippet.title: A small farewell - Made by fans for fans.
snippet.description:
https://stargate-network.com/

(All renders were made in 2018-2021 on Unreal Engine 4, the video does not represent the latest UE 5 version we were working on)

====================
⚠️ Disclaimer
Nov.2025 // Stargate is finally opening a new chapter with the recently announced show on Prime Video. We thought it would be a nice time to bring back a few videos of our cancelled video game project. For the sake of looking back at our contribution to the fanbase during Stargate's longest drought. 
A small display of nostalgia showing how meaningful Stargate is to us.
This video and this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders of Stargate, Amazon, or Prime Video.
====================
